confirmation_status: Yes (Confirmed by Direct Code & Data Evidence)
key_quantitative_evidence: Respiratory distress surrogate rule (rr_max>=24 | spo2_min<90 | diag) triggered in 189/189 (100.0%) of False Positive controls and 440/460 (95.7%) overall. In MIMIC training, it was present in only 51.7% of patients and has the single highest feature importance in the model.
recommended_action: Replace surrogate rule with strict clinical charting flag or set unrecorded symptom to NaN for native model imputation.

suspected_cause_or_hypothesis: Spectrum Bias of ICU Non-Pneumonia Controls
confirmation_status: Yes (Confirmed by Direct Clinical Diagnoses Evidence)
key_quantitative_evidence: eICU controls are not healthy individuals; they are critically ill ICU patients with Septic Shock (n=14), Congestive Heart Failure (n=15), DKA (n=10), Acute MI (n=14), and Bronchitis/COPD (n=11). 14/15 CHF, 14/14 Sepsis, and 9/10 DKA patients were classified as False Positives due to real systemic tachycardia, tachypnea, and hypotension.
recommended_action: Evaluate external validation against true ambulatory outpatients or mild inpatient respiratory controls; document spectrum bias in thesis.

suspected_cause_or_hypothesis: Extreme-Value Vital Inflation via Continuous Telemetry & Long Stays
key_quantitative_evidence: FP controls had mean monitoring duration of 107.7 hours (vs 53.2 hours in TN controls, p<0.0001) with thousands of 5-min readings. Extreme-value features (spo2_min, rr_max, sbp_min, spo2_drop, shock_index) were mathematically driven to extremes over 4-day stays, causing NEWS score to reach 10.35 in FP controls (vs 6.44 in TN).
recommended_action: Standardize observation windows to a fixed 24-hour admission window rather than entire multi-day ICU stays.

suspected_cause_or_hypothesis: Prior Probability Shift & Unadjusted Frozen Threshold (0.53)
confirmation_status: Yes (Confirmed by Bayesian Odds & Calibration Evidence)
key_quantitative_evidence: Model was trained on 74.79% pneumonia prevalence with balanced class weights. At frozen threshold 0.53, model assumes a high prior probability of pneumonia. Adjusting the threshold to 0.77 (matching balanced 50% cohort) recovers specificity from 17.83% to 63.91% with balanced accuracy 69.35%.
recommended_action: Apply prevalence-adaptive Bayesian threshold recalibration for balanced or low-prevalence deployment settings.

confirmation_status: Yes (Confirmed by Unit and Missingness Inspection)
key_quantitative_evidence: CRP was charted in mg/dL in eICU (vs mg/L in MIMIC) without unit conversion, reaching values up to 2,840 mg/dL. However, 94.35% of eICU patients lacked CRP and were filled with training median 6.0 mg/L, dampening the net impact of the unit error across the cohort.
recommended_action: Apply unit conversion (x10 for mg/dL) and test model performance on lab-complete subsets.
